annotations.title: Best Clash Royale decks right now

description: The most played or highest win-rate Clash Royale decks from recent real battles of top players, with usage and win rate. Use for "best deck", "meta decks", "best Hog Rider deck", "decks without Mega Knight" and similar questions.

days.description: How many recent days of battles to count.

exclude_cards.description: Card names no deck may contain.

include_cards.description: Card names every deck must contain, e.g. ["Hog Rider"].

scope.description: Whose games to count: top100 / top1000 ranked Path of Legends players (default), or all tracked players.

sort.description: Most played, or highest win rate (decks with enough games only).

name: top_decks
